figs.name: rc-low-pass-high-pass-filter-design-flowchart
figs.alt: RC filter design flowchart with 1 kHz low pass example using 10 nF and 15 kohm
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the RC filter design steps with Example 1: 1 kHz cutoff, 10 nF capacitor, 15 kohm resistor, 1061 Hz check and gain at 5 kHz.
figs.after_h2: Two Worked Examples for RC Filter Design
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>RC filter design flowchart with the 1 kHz low pass worked example</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9d174d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RC Filter Design Steps with Example 1</text>
<text x="205" y="70" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Design step</text>
<text x="600" y="70" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example 1: low pass, 1 kHz</text>
<rect x="30" y="84" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="121.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Set required fc</text>
<rect x="430" y="84" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="120.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fc = 1000 Hz, audio noise</text>
<line x1="382" y1="115" x2="428" y2="115" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="146" x2="205" y2="161" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="162" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Choose a standard C</text>
<rect x="430" y="162" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="198.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">C = 10 nF (0.01 µF)</text>
<line x1="382" y1="193" x2="428" y2="193" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="224" x2="205" y2="239" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="240" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="277.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. R = 1 ÷ (2π × fc × C)</text>
<rect x="430" y="240" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="276.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R = 15,915 Ω</text>
<line x1="382" y1="271" x2="428" y2="271" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="302" x2="205" y2="317" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="318" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="355.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Round to standard R</text>
<rect x="430" y="318" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="354.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Use 15 kΩ (or 16 kΩ)</text>
<line x1="382" y1="349" x2="428" y2="349" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="380" x2="205" y2="395" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="396" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="433.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Verify fc = 1 ÷ (2πRC)</text>
<rect x="430" y="396" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="432.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fc = 1061 Hz, close enough</text>
<line x1="382" y1="427" x2="428" y2="427" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="205" y1="458" x2="205" y2="473" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="474" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="511.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. Check gain at test f</text>
<rect x="430" y="474" width="340" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#db2777" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">At 5 kHz: Xc = 3183 Ω</text>
<text x="600.0" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gain 0.208, minus 13.6 dB</text>
<line x1="382" y1="505" x2="428" y2="505" stroke="#9d174d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="572" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">With R chosen first, use C = 1 ÷ (2π × fc × R) instead.</text>
</svg>
